title: Benchmark CRDT reconcile for 10k-entry log
description:
Add a criterion benchmark that runs reconcile() on two in-memory LogStorage instances, each with 10,000 entries, diverged at entry 9,000. Measures time to compute the want/have sets. Artifact: crates/core/benches/reconcile.rs.

Acceptance criteria:
- benchmark is deterministic (seeded RNG for entry generation)
- reports p50/p99 reconcile time
- result is in the hundreds of milliseconds or less (otherwise flag as regression risk)
